timing: Before implementation qualification, source lock, or any registered-seed diagnostic execution.
reason: The original protocol fixed the probe evidence and query time but did not explicitly fix the time supplied to the time-retained control during the counterfactual support probe. Allowing probe time to track prefix would confound explicit position with P-state dependence.

repair.rule: Use the fixed in-distribution midpoint for every control probe at every prefix, so only the cloned P state varies with prefix. Never infer the natural support time from the prefix for this probe battery.

all Stage-2 support and query interventions
